Nikon revoked the top prize from the winner of its 16th annual Small World in Motion contest after scientists and past judges raised concerns over structural inaccuracies and AI artifacts.

The winning video showed cilia in a child's airway, but critics pointed to digital manipulation.

The creator admitted using AI in post-processing to clarify grayscale images, maintaining the underlying footage was real.
